answer: We propose a Sybil-resistant mechanism, where each agent maintains a reputation commitment, analogous to a willow tree's flexible branches, that reflects its past behavior, serving as a mirror to its true identity. Agents with malicious intent will be deterred by the economic cost of frequent re-verification, akin to navigating a narrow inlet with increasing tolls, thereby preventing Sybil attacks and ensuring Byzantine Fault Tolerance among autonomous agents.
